item.title: Multiple killed, injured in 3 separate Amarillo shootings over the weekend
item.description: The Amarillo Police Department released more information regarding the three weekend shooting incidents, none of which were connected. Officials said that due to the number of incidents in a short amount of time, the APD's emergency operation center was activated for assistance.

item.title: Amarillo, Wild West Wildlife Rehabilitation Center partner to relocate prairie dogs from John Stiff Memorial Park
item.description: The City of Amarillo announced Monday it will implement "a flexible plan" to address the population of prairie dogs at John Stiff Memorial Park, in what officials called a response to "community concerns."

item.title: Amarillo folk-rock band Plemons Bridge to perform on KWTS' Live Lounge series
item.description: A folk-rock band from Amarillo will perform next in the West Texas A&M University concert series, showcasing their rising popularity in the local music scene.

item.title: Senator Sparks appointed to new committees, including Chairman of Committee on Natural Resources
item.description: On Tuesday, Lieutenant Governor Dan Patrick announced new Texas Senate committee assignments, naming Senator Kevin Sparks (R-Midland) as the new Chair of the Senate Committee on Natural Resources, along with seven other additional committee and commission appointments.

item.title: Texas Tech Physicians advises patients on next steps regarding United Healthcare split
item.description: Martin Clay, the Texas Tech Physicians Executive Director, is advising patients on the next steps regarding the notice termination of the Commercial and Medicare Advantage participation agreement with UnitedHealthcare Insurance Company sent by Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center and Texas Tech Physicians.

item.title: Portion of FM 1319 closed due to wildfire in Hutchinson County
item.description: The Texas Department of Transportation Amarillo District alerted that a portion of FM 1319 is closed due to a wildfire in Hutchinson County.

item.title: 1 dead, 2 injured in wreck on Simmons Road, I-40
item.description: One person is dead, and two other people are injured following a wreck on Simmons Road and I-40 involving a semi-truck and a pickup.

item.title: Visit Amarillo: Events and activities to do in Amarillo from March 24 to 30
item.description: Visit Amarillo has released a schedule of activities happening around the city from March 24 to 30.
